name: round-standing
title: A standing round posts its words into its Cattain's own thread
about: A round of miso's, standing (it posts into miso's own thread), is made in the New round panel: Cattain miso, Post in miso's own thread on, no project to choose. Run now posts its words: miso's thread shows them as "From the round Morning check" and miso's run reads them in a <neko-wake kind="round">. No thread of its own is made, and the round's card says where it posts.

steps.expect: The New round panel opens, for no Cattain
A new round from the page belongs to nobody until a Cattain is chosen

steps.text: Look over the open pull requests [fake:plain]

steps.expect: With a Cattain, the panel offers Post in miso's own thread
A standing round has no project to choose

steps.name: panel
steps.expect: The panel: miso, Post in miso's own thread
The card says where it posts, led by miso's face
Its last line leads to miso's own thread
miso's thread shows the round's words as a message from the round
miso's run read them and ended

sh.run: grep '"stdin"' fake-record.jsonl | grep 'neko-wake kind=..round' | grep -c 'Morning check' || true
/usr/bin/sqlite3 "$data/neko.sqlite3" "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE round_id IS NOT NULL"
/usr/bin/sqlite3 "$data/neko.sqlite3" "SELECT t.cattain FROM round_runs r JOIN tasks t ON t.id = r.task_id"

steps.expect: miso's own thread read the round's words; no thread of the round's own was made

steps.name: posted
steps.expect: From the round Morning check, in miso's thread, and miso's answer
